## Friday weekend-brief email

Intended issue: Friday 18 September, 15:30 UK, after fresh checks. Retire before Saturday 19 September 08:00 UK. Do not describe tickets as available without checking.

Subject: Birmingham: two free plans, plus a Tudor detour

Preheader: Helios on Saturday, mini-museum making on Sunday.

Hi Birmingham,

Your small weekend shortlist for **19–20 September**:

- **Saturday, free:** [Helios at The Exchange](https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/the-exchange/events/helios), 8am–5pm. No booking for the illuminated Sun sculpture at Centenary Square. A grown-up-and-child stop rather than a supervised session. The venue is not listed as open on Sunday.
- **Sunday, free:** [Make a Mini Museum](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/events/marvellous-makers), Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery, 11am–3pm. All ages, drop-in; stay with your children.
- **Optional paid Saturday:** [Explore Blakesley](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/events/heritage-open-day-and-birmingham-heritage-week-explore-blakesley) in Yardley. £5 adult / £3 child advertised; all ages. Pre-book a timed Hall entry between 11am and 3pm; grounds close 4pm. Check the final checkout total. This heritage visit is not free.

[Visit DoNext Birmingham](https://donext.co.uk/birmingham/)

The DoNext team 🧡

## Weekday subscriber email

Intended issue: Monday 14 September morning. Recheck opening arrangements first. Copy window ends Friday 18 September at 17:00 UK; do not reuse as a Sunday recommendation.

Subject: Birmingham: a free little space stop this week

Preheader: Helios at The Exchange — no ticket needed.

Hi Birmingham,

Have a small gap in the day? [Helios at The Exchange](https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/events/helios-by-luke-jerram) is a free stop for **14–18 September**, with published weekday hours of **8am–5pm**.

Find the illuminated Sun sculpture at **3 Centenary Square**. No booking needed. We’d pick it for school-age space fans, with younger children welcome alongside their grown-ups; there’s a soundscape, so it isn’t a silent space or a toddler class.

Keep it short or linger — the café is optional and closes at 4pm. Check the venue page before travelling.
